sourceAuthority: Local runtime probe for the R survey backend selected by the NHANES public-use LMF weighted-estimator readiness contract.

syntheticSmokeCases.purpose: Detect whether Rscript is present in the current execution environment without installing packages or changing system state.
Load the mature R survey package selected by the upstream weighted-estimator readiness contract.
Build a small synthetic svydesign object with psu, strata, weight and nest = TRUE, then evaluate a domain subset without touching public NHANES rows.

readinessGates.evidence: The upstream weighted-estimator readiness path, sha256 and validation output must match before runtime smoke probing is accepted.
A repository validator probes Rscript and the survey package without installing dependencies, downloading data or persisting rows.
The validation output records whether Rscript is present in the current environment.
The validation output records whether the R survey package can be loaded.
The validation output records whether a synthetic svydesign object and domain subset smoke test passes.
Even a passing synthetic runtime smoke test does not authorize NHANES weighted domain output, confidence intervals, calibration, causal claims or individual prediction.

nextWork: Run this validator in an environment with Rscript and the R survey package installed.
If the synthetic smoke passes, keep public NHANES weighted output blocked until domain indicator, degrees-of-freedom, sparse-domain and disclosure gates pass.
Add domain degrees-of-freedom and sparse-domain test cases before any public weighted domain rates or design-based intervals are generated.
